services.desc: Join us for Perfect Puzzle Night at Perfect Plain on Monday, August 3! Gather your team (1-4 people) and put your puzzle-solving skills to the test in a fast-paced race against the clock. Teams will have 2 hours to complete a 500-piece puzzle. When time runs out, the team with the completed puzzle-or the fewest pieces remaining-takes home the win and ultimate bragging rights. Here's how it works:- Teams of 1-4 players- Spend $20 in the taproom and your puzzle is included- Don't hit the minimum?
